newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Chubais, IMF's Camdessus to meet - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Chubais, IMF's Camdessus to meet - Tass.

text.p: Russia's economic supremo Anatoly Chubais would hold talks on April 1 with International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus, Prime-Tass news agency said.
The agency did not give any other details.
Chubais announced the meeting after talks with coalminers in Kemerovo, Siberia, where he promised to pay off wage arrears.
Russia and the IMF have been working on an economic programme for 1997 under Russia's current $10 billion three-year loan from the fund.
Both sides said the programme would be completed last week, but an IMF mission left Moscow this week without agreeing it.

The mission is due to return next week. Russian officials said the delay was due to this month's cabinet reshuffle, but former First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin said Russia and the IMF disagreed on how fast natural monopolies should be restructured -- something the IMF is pressing for.
With taxes running well below budgeted levels, the government has been forced to slash spending, contributing to the build up in wage arrears as public-sector workers go unpaid.
Chubais told the miners that federal government revenues were currently running at only 60-65 percent of budgeted levels, Prime-Tass said.
